shortDescription: Manages ZIA Traffic Capture policy rules

options.name: action
options.description: The action to be enforced when the traffic matches the rule criteria.

options.name: api_key
options.description: A string that contains the obfuscated API key.

options.name: app_service_groups
options.description: List of application service group IDs.

options.name: client_id
options.description: The client ID for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: client_secret
options.description: The client secret for OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: cloud
options.description: The Zscaler cloud name provisioned for your organization.

options.name: default_rule
options.description: If set to true, the default rule is applied.

options.name: departments
options.description: List of department IDs for which the rule must be applied.

options.name: description
options.description: Additional information about the rule. Maximum 10240 characters.

options.name: dest_addresses
options.description: Destination addresses. Supports IPv4, FQDNs, or wildcard FQDNs.

options.name: dest_countries
options.description: Destination countries. Provide ISO3166 Alpha2 codes (e.g., US, BR).

options.name: dest_ip_categories
options.description: IP address categories of destination.

options.name: dest_ip_groups
options.description: List of destination IP group IDs.

options.name: device_groups
options.description: List of device group IDs (for Zscaler Client Connector managed devices).

options.name: device_trust_levels
options.description: Device trust levels for the rule application.

options.name: devices
options.description: List of device IDs for which the rule must be applied.

options.name: exclude_src_countries
options.description: Indicates whether source countries are excluded from the rule.

options.name: groups
options.description: List of group IDs for which the rule must be applied.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier for the Traffic Capture rule. Used to reference an existing rule for update or delete.

options.name: labels
options.description: List of label IDs applicable to the rule.

options.name: location_groups
options.description: List of location group IDs.

options.name: locations
options.description: List of location IDs for which the rule must be applied.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Traffic Capture policy rule. Required for create.

options.name: nw_application_groups
options.description: List of network application group IDs.

options.name: nw_applications
options.description: Network application names.

options.name: nw_service_groups
options.description: List of network service group IDs.

options.name: nw_services
options.description: List of network service IDs.

options.name: order
options.description: Rule order number. If omitted, the rule will be added to the end of the rule set.

options.name: password
options.description: A string that contains the password for the API admin.

options.name: predefined
options.description: If set to true, a predefined rule is applied.

options.name: private_key
options.description: The private key for JWT-based OAuth2 authentication.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict containing authentication credentials.

options.name: rank
options.description: Admin rank of the rule (0-7).

options.name: rule_state
options.description: Determines whether the rule is enabled or disabled.

options.name: sandbox_cloud
options.description: The Sandbox cloud environment for API access.

options.name: sandbox_token
options.description: A string that contains the Sandbox API Key.

options.name: source_countries
options.description: Source countries. Provide ISO3166 Alpha2 codes.

options.name: src_ip_groups
options.description: List of source IP group IDs.

options.name: src_ips
options.description: User-defined source IP addresses for which the rule is applicable.

options.name: state
options.description: Specifies the desired state of the resource.

options.name: time_windows
options.description: The time interval in which the rule applies.

options.name: txn_sampling
options.description: The percentage of connections sampled for capturing each time the rule is triggered.

options.name: txn_size_limit
options.description: The maximum size of traffic to capture per connection.

options.name: use_legacy_client
options.description: Whether to use the legacy Zscaler API client.

options.name: username
options.description: A string that contains the email ID of the API admin.

options.name: users
options.description: List of user IDs for which the rule must be applied.

options.name: vanity_domain
options.description: The vanity domain provisioned by Zscaler for OAuth2 flows.

options.name: workload_groups
options.description: List of preconfigured workload group IDs.
